about_the_game:
Space Depot is a casual space sim management game.

Unemployed in a utopian future, you've just received a job offer for Depot Manager with ZENCORP Logistics and Distribution. No need for pants. This is a work-from-home position. You'll telecommute 23 billion miles to manage the logistics needs of a small sector of outposts. Each one relies on the system to be functioning for your space depot to thrive and for ZENCORP to realize a future where everyone has what they need. 

Features

  • Repair solar panels to keep your energy grid functioning.

  • Receive and store materials from outpost in the sector. 

  • Manage incoming hazardous material, like explosives that have to be stabilized and shipments that need to be decontaminated. 

  • Prepare for asteroid fields by purchasing more asteroid blasters to protect your valuable cargo.

  • Communicate with outpost to determine their needs, then strategize which outpost orders you are able to fulfill. 

  • Grow your outpost rep and receive rewards such as drone skins, health, battery, and speed upgrades.

Thank you for choosing ZENCORP to further your employment goals!
